question: Which minimal GLM-4.7 Flash MoE execution proxy can plausibly reach the campaign's 10% committed-price c16 cost-path threshold before post-training?

scope.workload: retained decode traces; production normalization uses current 8192-input/1024-output c16 result
scope.quality: semantics-changing architecture-cost proxy; no quality claim

proxy_method.replicate_rule: Use the smaller share across the two retained decode traces.
proxy_method.top3_routed: Remove one of four routed experts and credit only one quarter of measured fused marlin_moe time.
proxy_method.top2_routed: Remove two of four routed experts and credit only one half of measured fused marlin_moe time.
proxy_method.no_shared: Credit all observed standard Marlin plus the explicitly shared fused residual. This is deliberately an upper ceiling because the trace does not attribute every standard Marlin call to the shared expert.
proxy_method.combined: Add top-2 routed and no-shared ceilings; routing/sort, attention, KV, and all unassigned work receive zero credit.

interpretation.chip_mechanism: At c16 the measured endpoint is GPU-saturated. The fused routed AWQ Marlin kernel alone occupies 12.37% of summed decode kernel duration in the lower trace; removing routed expert work is therefore the only individual MoE proxy with more than a few percent trace ceiling. A shared-expert removal has a separate standard-Marlin/residual path, but attribution is incomplete.
interpretation.falsification: Neither top-3, top-2, nor shared-expert removal alone has a sufficient trace-resident ceiling for the committed-price target. The combined candidate clears the gate only by 3.33 percentage points of ideal nonoverlapped wall-time reduction; any meaningful overlap, kernel-shape regression, or non-shared standard-Marlin attribution closes it.
interpretation.next_move: If the director opens the existing bounded L40S mutation authority, run one retained c16 session with stock c16 control and a top-2-plus-no-shared runtime proxy. Require complete requests, exact geometry, semantic diagnostics, and report this arm as quality-changing. Promote only if measured output throughput reaches 594.46 tok/s (the $0.514/M planning-rate equivalent); otherwise close this combined MoE execution route.
